scripts.web:pwa: npm --prefix frontend/hallen-app run build && npm --prefix frontend/hallen-app run preview
scripts.build: dotnet build backend && npm --prefix frontend/hallen-app run build
scripts.restore: dotnet restore backend && npm --prefix frontend/hallen-app install
scripts.db:update: dotnet ef database update --project backend/Hallen.Database --startup-project backend/Hallen.Api
scripts.db:remove: dotnet ef migrations remove --project backend/Hallen.Database --startup-project backend/Hallen.Api
